SELECT substr(ym.Date, 5, 2) AS month
FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym
JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY SUM(ym.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1;
